text.zh: 东南亚热带地区午后地表被强太阳辐射加热，近地层空气急剧升温膨胀上升，水汽在强烈对流中凝结成积雨云，常在傍晚前后骤降短时强降水，即“对流雨”，来得快去得也快。
text.en: In tropical SE Asia, afternoon solar heating warms the surface; warm moist air rises rapidly, condenses into cumulonimbus in strong convection, and often dumps brief intense rain toward evening — convective rain that comes and goes quickly.

tip.zh: 建议将户外活动安排在上午，午后备伞；对流雨通常持续30-60分钟。
tip.en: Schedule outdoor activities in the morning, carry an umbrella after noon; convective rain usually lasts 30–60 min.

text.zh: 夜间山谷冷空气下沉聚集，形成“冷湖”并出现气温随高度增加的逆温层，水汽在谷底饱和凝结成雾。日出后地面受热、逆温破坏，雾逐渐抬升消散。
text.en: At night cold air drains into valleys forming a 'cold lake' with a temperature inversion (warmer aloft); moisture saturates into fog. After sunrise heating breaks the inversion and fog lifts.

tip.zh: 晨雾时段能见度低，山路湿滑注意行车；雾散后通透度极佳适合拍摄。
tip.en: Low visibility on slippery mountain roads in fog; after it lifts, clarity is excellent for photography.

text.zh: 中南半岛受海陆热力差异驱动，形成干湿季分明的季风气候：5-10月西南季风带来丰沛降水（雨季），11-4月东北季风干凉少雨（旱季）。
text.en: The Indochina Peninsula is driven by land–sea thermal contrast into a monsoon climate with distinct wet/dry seasons: SW monsoon brings heavy rain May–Oct (wet), NE monsoon is dry and cool Nov–Apr (dry).

tip.zh: 雨季出行关注台风与强对流；旱季阳光强注意防晒补水。
tip.en: In wet season watch typhoons and convection; in dry season the sun is strong—use sun protection and hydrate.

text.zh: 台风是发生在热带洋面的强烈气旋，需较高海温(≥26.5℃)与较小垂直风切变。南海台风多见于6-11月，可带来狂风暴雨与风暴增水，影响越南中北部及泰国湾沿岸。
text.en: Typhoons are intense tropical cyclones over warm oceans (SST≥26.5°C) with low vertical wind shear. South China Sea typhoons peak Jun–Nov, bringing destructive wind, rain and storm surge to central-northern Vietnam and the Gulf of Thailand.

tip.zh: 台风影响期避免出海与跳岛，关注港口停航与航班变动。
tip.en: Avoid sea trips and island hopping during typhoon influence; watch port and flight disruptions.

text.zh: 旱季中南半岛部分地区存在刀耕火种与秸秆焚烧，细颗粒物(PM2.5)在稳定大气下积聚形成跨境雾霾，能见度下降、呼吸道刺激增强，常随风向扩散至邻国。
text.en: In the dry season, slash-and-burn and crop-residue burning in parts of Indochina releases PM2.5 that accumulates under stable air into cross-border haze, reducing visibility and irritating airways, drifting with the wind.

tip.zh: 雾霾严重时减少户外剧烈运动，佩戴N95口罩，关注空气质量指数。
tip.en: Reduce strenuous outdoor activity in heavy haze, wear an N95 mask, and monitor the air quality index.

text.zh: 白天陆地升温快于海面，陆面空气上升、海上较凉空气流向陆地形成海风；夜间相反形成陆风。海岸城市傍晚海风带来凉爽，是户外活动黄金时段。
text.en: By day land heats faster than the sea; warm air rises over land and cool sea air flows in (sea breeze). At night the reverse (land breeze). Coastal evenings cooled by the sea breeze are prime outdoor time.

tip.zh: 傍晚海边体感最佳，但近岸浪与离岸流需留意安全。
tip.en: Evenings by the sea feel best, but watch nearshore waves and rip currents for safety.
